metadata.title: Windows Server 2025 directory data (outside the root DSE) of a nonpublic directory must be configured to prevent anonymous access.

criterion.comment: Windows Server directory data (outside the root DSE) of a nonpublic directory must be configured to prevent anonymous access. Analyze the dsHeuristics to check for annonymous access.

Windows Server directory data (outside the root DSE) of a nonpublic directory must be configured to prevent anonymous access. Verify ANONYMOUS LOGON permissions are not allowed on Active Directory Users and Computers domain security permission settings.

independent-def:shellcommand_test.comment: Analyze the dsHeuristics to check for annonymous access.

Open Active Directory Users and Computers. Select View - Advanced Features. Right click on domain name in left pane (which is listed under Active Directory Users and Computers) and click properties. Select the Security Tab and click Advanced. Verify Allow permissions of any kind are not granted to ANONYMOUS LOGON.

independent-def:shellcommand_object.comment: Analyse permissions on Active Directory Users and Computers. Domain Security Permissions via PowerShell.
independent-def:shellcommand_object.independent-def:command: if (([adsi]"LDAP://$((Get-ADDomain).DistinguishedName)").PSBase.ObjectSecurity.GetAccessRules($true, $true, [System.Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier]) | Where-Object { $_.IdentityReference -eq 'S-1-5-7' -and $_.AccessControlType -eq 'Allow' }) { Write-Host "FAIL: ANONYMOUS LOGON is configured with ALLOW permissions." } else { Write-Host "PASS: ANONYMOUS LOGON is missing or does not have ALLOW permissions." }

independent-def:shellcommand_object.comment: Analyze the dsHeuristics to check for annonymous access
independent-def:shellcommand_object.independent-def:command: $( try { $obj=Get-ADObject -Filter "objectClass -eq 'nTDSService'" -Properties dsHeuristics -SearchBase "CN=Services,$((Get-ADRootDSE).configurationNamingContext)" -ErrorAction Stop; if ($null -eq $obj) { throw } $h=$obj.dsHeuristics; if ($null -eq $h) { [PSCustomObject]@{ Status='PASS'; Detail='dsHeuristics attribute is not set (Defaults secure)' } } else { $isAnon=($h.Length -ge 7) -and ($h[6] -eq '2'); $stat=if($isAnon){'FAIL'}else{'PASS'}; $msg=if($isAnon){'Allows Anonymous Access'}else{'Secure'}; $c=if($h.Length -ge 7){$h[6]}else{'N/A'}; [PSCustomObject]@{ Status=$stat; Detail=("dsHeuristics value is [{0}]. Seventh char is '{1}' ({2})." -f $h,$c,$msg) } } } catch { [PSCustomObject]@{ Status='ERROR'; Detail="Directory Service object could not be located or read." } } ) | Out-String -Width 4096

independent-def:shellcommand_state.comment: No lines shall exist listed with status of 'FAIL'
